_comment: Search engine and link preview data of the public pages: titles, descriptions, languages, image and structured data (JSON-LD). Used by js/seo.js in the browser and by scripts/prerender.mjs at build time. A value like {"en": ..., "es": ...} is picked by language. Every page listed here exists in every language of `languages`, at its path (English) or under the language's prefix (/es/...).
